verdict.rationale: Reviewing a public security-advisory or CVE history is a fair question for an open-source web framework, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers a security advisories page, CVE listings, a disclosure policy or vulnerability-handling history; the items describe only features, CLI commands and community opinions on usability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review the project's public CVE/security-advisory history to judge its track record of handling and disclosing vulnerabilities
